# GoethePrep

> GoethePrep is an unofficial iOS app (iPhone and iPad) for Goethe German exam preparation at CEFR levels A1–B2. App Store only.

## Domains

| Site | URL | Focus |
|------|-----|-------|
| Main (all levels) | https://goetheprep.com/ | Hub, A1–B2 overview |
| A1 | https://a1.goetheprep.com/ | Goethe-Zertifikat A1 |
| A2 | https://a2.goetheprep.com/ | Goethe-Zertifikat A2 |
| B1 | https://b1.goetheprep.com/ | Goethe-Zertifikat B1 |
| B2 | https://b2.goetheprep.com/ | Goethe-Zertifikat B2 |

Sitemap: https://goetheprep.com/sitemap.xml

## App

Platform: iOS 16+ (iPhone and iPad). App Store only.

Features per level: 7 practice exams (/100), quick drills, audio, AI writing review, stats.

Not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut.

## Blog structure

- Main blog: https://goetheprep.com/blog/ — cross-level guides
- Level blogs: https://{level}.goetheprep.com/blog/ — e.g. b1.goetheprep.com/blog/

Each level site has a dedicated exam format article plus shared guides (passing score, Hören, Schreiben, study plan).

## Regenerating sites

After editing site.config.json, run: `python3 scripts/generate-level-sites.py`

## Deployment

See deploy/README.md for GitHub Pages and subdomain DNS setup.
